title: Zephyrine and the Alibi
author: Zephyrine Marchetti
blurb: Ines Joubert, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
